title: The same schema models the attention of others

statements.text: An attention schema can also model the attention states of other people, and so supports social cognition. Attributing awareness to another person amounts to building a simplified model of that person’s attention.

sources.locator: A Theory of Consciousness that Embodies Principles 1 and 2
sources.quote: an attention schema could also be used to model the attention states of others, thus contributing to social cognition
we are in effect constructing a simplified model of other people’s state of attention
